Running Windows commands as ADMIN from WSL: WSL runs non-elevated. Use scheduled task 'HermesElevated' (RunLevel=Highest, runs as rdp, LogonType=Interactive — only works when rdp session is logged in). Workflow with 3 files in /mnt/c/Users/rdp/hermes-elevated/: (1) write Windows command to cmd.cmd (goes inside cmd.exe /c, so cmd pipes/redirection work), (2) trigger via /mnt/c/Windows/System32/schtasks.exe /Run /TN HermesElevated, (3) wait 3-5s, read out.txt (stdout+stderr), exitcode.txt, meta.txt (confirms elevated=True = High integrity SID S-1-16-12288). Each trigger overwrites the 3 output files. For PowerShell: printf 'powershell -NoProfile -Command "..."' > cmd.cmd. Security: anyone who can write cmd.cmd runs elevated (acceptable single-user). WSL↔Windows interop (binfmt_misc WSLInterop) was re-enabled and persisted in /etc/wsl.conf ([interop] enabled=true, appendWindowsPath=true).
Rodrigo quer uma interface Hermes mais parecida com Claude Code: personalizável, com inspeção de tools, agents/subagents, sessões, status e informações operacionais.

Gaming Center replacement project (2026-07-03): workspace /home/rodrigo/gaming-center-re; Kanban board gaming-center-replacement; OEM app installed at C:\Program Files\OEM\GamingCenter on Rodrigo-Avell. Main app GamingCenter.exe is .NET Framework 4.6.1/WPF; EC control uses root\WMI AcpiTest_MULong ACPI\PNP0C14\1_1 GetSetULong. Read adds 1099511627776 to address; write sends (value << 16) + address. Initial fan mapping: EC addr 1873 normal=0, boost=64, custom level=128+level, advanced=160; PWM addrs 1859..1863. Decompiled source at C:\Users\rdp\RE-tools\gaming-center-decompiled. Safety: no EC writes without Rodrigo approval.

BIOS/ACPI do Avell G1555 resolvido: o GPE storm foi neutralizado por override em HKLM\HARDWARE\ACPI, com DSDT cache ALASKA\A_M_I_\01072009 renomeando _L69→XL69 e SSD8\RDRG\GPEFIX\00001000 injetando _L69 no-op. O fluxo de acompanhamento do fornecedor foi encerrado; não é mais necessário monitorar respostas nem enviar follow-ups.

BIOS custom firmware investigation started 2026-07-06. Workspace: /home/rodrigo/bios-investigation. Goal: analyze/repair AMI N.1.03 BIOS for GJ5CN6E (ACPI _ADR bug). Toolchain: iasl (acpica-tools), acpiexec, UEFIExtract_NE_A74, UEFITool pending, AMIBCP pending. Blocker: no BIOS dump yet. Research conclusions from Mac-Claude fan-out: OS-level ACPI override is safest path (no flash); if patching is needed, minimal-change SSDT workflow. WSL2 bug `psutil.create_time()` drift: jittera ~1-2s (psutil deriva de `time.time() - /proc/uptime`). `mcp_stdio_watchdog.py`/`tui_gateway/slash_worker.py` usavam-no p/ detectar órfãos — drift flipava após ~12s, SIGTERM em MCPs stdio num loop ~10-30s (parecia "gateway restarted"). Fix commit `dd6c0e36e` no fork rodrigogs (origin/main): lê ticks do `/proc/<pid>/stat` campo 22.

Hermes upstream PR workflow: o repo local /usr/local/lib/hermes-agent é fork rodrigogs (origin) com upstream NousResearch. main local tem +1158 carried commits — NÃO abrir PR de main. Para PRs limpos: criar branch de upstream/main (`git checkout -b fix/x upstream/main`), cherry-pick, push pro origin (fork), abrir PR via `gh pr create --repo NousResearch/hermes-agent --base main --head rodrigogs:branch`. PR #62928 = fix WSL2 psutil create_time drift (watchdog false-orphan).

Z.AI has separate balances: `https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4` is the funded coding endpoint; `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4` previously returned 429/c1113. Canonical Hermes routing uses the coding endpoint as the first runtime fallback for all profiles. Auxiliary slots use `provider: auto` and delegation inherits the primary/fallback policy rather than carrying duplicate provider overrides.

Script ~/.local/bin/wsl-portproxy-sync.sh: auto-sync portproxies Windows→WSL após IP mudar. Usa HermesElevated (schtasks RunLevel=Highest) para rodar netsh como admin. Sincroniza portas 2222 (SSH bridge) e 9119 (Hermes dashboard). Cron job 'wsl-portproxy-sync' (bd7a41d80d75) roda a cada 5min, no_agent=True, silent quando OK. WSL2 networkingMode=nat → IP interno 172.24.x muda a cada reboot.

parrot-hack: private repo rodrigogs/parrot-hack cloned at /home/rodrigo/parrot-hack. Hermes Project `parrot-hack` (id p_17467cde) bound to Kanban board `parrot-hack`. Python 3.10+ BLE/firmware reverse-engineering toolkit for Parrot Mambo. Primary context file: CLAUDE.md. Hardware safety: no BLE connect, firmware flash, motor spin, USB/RNDIS write, or flight attempt without Rodrigo physically present and explicitly approving exact operation. Skill: parrot-hack-operations.

parrot-hack bootstrap note: when creating hardware-gated Kanban tasks on board `parrot-hack`, `--initial-status blocked` returned 'Created ... (blocked)' but dispatcher still briefly spawned coder workers for the three tasks. Mitigation used: explicitly `hermes kanban --board parrot-hack block --kind needs_input <task>` and kill stray `hermes -p coder ... work kanban task ...` PIDs, then verify stats running=0 and no matching processes. Skill `parrot-hack-operations` documents this pitfall.

Parrot Mambo USB identity confirmed on Windows: VID:PID 19CF:0907, serial PI040408AA7I646426, bus-reported description `Mambo v3.0.26`. Windows history exposes USBSTOR `USB Mass Storage Device`, WPD `Parrot_Mini`, and disk identity `Linux File-CD Gadget`. On 2026-07-13 it arrived at 23:11:06 and was removed at 23:12:07; subsequent live polling showed Present=False / CM_PROB_PHANTOM, with no RNDIS adapter, mounted volume, usbipd connected entry, or WSL USB device.

Parrot Mambo stock firmware 3.0.26 has a verified USB debug path in its extracted scripts: with USB VBUS present, four quick button presses select shortpress_4.sh, which switches from g_mass_storage to g_multi, exposes usb0 at 192.168.2.1 with DHCP leases 192.168.2.2-3, ttyGS0 passwordless root shell, telnet, FTP 21 rooted at /data/ftp, FTP 51 rooted at /update, and HTTP 80. A single press selects shortpress_1.sh and shuts the drone down. Normal mass-storage mode also auto-ejects/powers off after 60 seconds without access.

Parrot-hack transport architecture decision: prefer a capability-based unified mamboctl with UsbDebugBackend for shell/files/update, optional WifiArsdkBackend for Mambo FPV (3.0.26 default 192.168.99.3:44444 plus negotiated UDP), and BleArsdkBackend as control/recovery fallback. Start with OS class drivers plus TCP/serial and a process-per-call Windows JSON helper; do not start with raw PyUSB or an always-on daemon.

parrot-hack: Parrot Mambo USB control is achieved without flashing. Stock debug mode exposes g_multi/RNDIS at drone 192.168.2.1. Verified paths: Windows RNDIS via signed wrapper INF for USB\VID_19CF&PID_0907&MI_00 with host 192.168.2.2/24; and WSL direct RNDIS via matched out-of-tree cdc_ether.ko + rndis_host.ko runtime-loaded from ~/.local/share/parrot-hack/mambo-rndis/6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2/, interface enxa6163fc699aa. Telnet 23 gives root BusyBox shell; ports 21/23/51/80 open.

parrot-hack Parrot Mambo live USB inventory found takeoff is rejected because vision/vertical camera health fails: logs show `Takeoff asked but Vision does not work`, repeated `/dev/vertical_camera` V4L timeouts, `Defective vertical camera detected`, and sensor-state `sensor=5 state=0`; report at `/home/rodrigo/parrot-hack/docs/mambo-live-inventory-findings.md`.

Parrot Mambo HW_12: carrega em debug mode a 500mA (porta PC SDP). Charger IC Qualcomm I2C 0x1c, reg 0x4A=0x87 = charging on. gpio_VBUS_DETECT sysfs dá -1 (erro) mas o charger IC é a fonte de verdade. 5s@120 nos 4 motores drenou a bateria abaixo do threshold (consumo > 500mA carga em PC). Carga rápida = DCP (parede) até 1600mA.

parrot-hack goal: evolve the repo into a safe framework for working with the Parrot Mambo drone, mapping tools, commands, data access paths, discoveries, functions, parameters, telemetry, and safety-gated control primitives.

Avell G1555 fix ACPI ativo em 2026-07-15 veio de override em HKLM\HARDWARE\ACPI, não da ESP/OpenCore. DSDT cache ALASKA\A_M_I_\01072009 tem XL69 (sem _L69) e SSD8\RDRG\GPEFIX\00001000 injeta SSDT no-op _L69. Provável `asl /loadtable`; `testsigning off` pode quebrar persistência no próximo boot.

Avell N.1.10/GJ5CN6E só foi encontrada em thread WinRAID de unlock/mod com `biosreg.bin`/FPT dumps. Prova que existiu em A52-5 BS, não que seja update oficial universal. Não flashar sem validar arquivo, DSDT, EC/ME e dados por máquina.

Avell/Windows: Intel Wireless-AC 9560 está plenamente habilitado após sequência EC idempotente: em 0x47B, bits WLAN 0x80 + BLTH 0x20; em 0x7A1, OR dos mesmos bits como trigger. Resultado verificado: Wi-Fi Intel conectado e Bluetooth Intel/VID_8087 enumerado, ambos WinRT On. O estado antigo de hardware disabled foi resolvido.

No Avell G1555, o Intel 9560 Bluetooth funciona via Windows após habilitar os bits EC WLAN/BLTH. WSL não possui HCI/BlueZ direto; clientes BLE devem rodar no Windows Python. Bleak 3.0.2 conectou ao Parrot Mambo `Mambo_646426` em `D0:3A:00:4B:E6:22`; timeout de 25s falhou no get_gatt_services_async, mas 60s funcionou com MTU 517 e 7 serviços GATT Parrot/GAP/GATT, mantendo USB/RNDIS simultâneo.

Parrot Mambo battery percentage is readable over BLE using the old parrot-hack protocol: subscribe to fb0e/fb0f/fb1b/fb1c, send Common.Common.AllSettings (0,2,0) then Common.Common.AllStates (0,4,0) over fa0b, and decode Common.CommonState.BatteryStateChanged (0,5,1) one-byte percent. Live Windows/Bleak test returned 0%; cable ADC samples were ~2.56–3.10 V equivalent, consistent with near-empty battery.

Hermes One autostart on Rodrigo's Avell is layered: Windows Scheduled Task `Hermes WSL Autostart` (logon trigger) starts/keeps Ubuntu-24.04 alive and explicitly ensures WSL user units hermes-webui.service + tailscaled-one.service; `Hermes WSL Watchdog` reruns every 5 minutes. Both units are enabled, linger=yes, and the launcher verifies local port 8787 plus https://one.javanese-beta.ts.net/health. Multiline Bash passed from PowerShell to wsl.exe must be Base64-encoded to avoid argument splitting.

Current Hermes Kanban authority policy: all 15 profiles use max_in_progress_per_profile=1, allowing parallelism across specialists but not within one profile. A canonical role-guard asset lives in the kanban-model-routing skill and is reconciled byte-identically into planner, researcher, reviewer, and auditor. It blocks local writes/code execution, interactive browser mutations, unknown or mutating MCP tools, and non-whitelisted terminal commands; reviewer/auditor permit only read-only git/gh inspection. Tester retains terminal/file/code_execution. Model/fallback policy is governed by the authoritative 2026-07-22 roster facts: openrouter/free must never be a production fallback because it returns HTTP 429; use paid OpenRouter or cross-rail Z.ai/Bedrock paths, with a non-Mac fallback for every Bedrock route. Canonical reconciliation command: `python3 scripts/reconcile.py --apply` from the kanban-model-routing skill directory.

Capability Router: v1 feature extending delegate-profile Hermes plugin (repo rodrigogs/hermes-delegate-profile, /mnt/c/Users/rodri/Workspace/hermes-delegate-profile). HYBRID router: Stage 0 = cheap deterministic rules every turn; Stage 1 = LLM classifier (glm-5.2/zai, temp-0) fires only on uncertainty. Output = profile + optional model override via delegate_profile(). Two ordered first-match tables. Non-Turing-complete rules. Blocklist v1 = static deny row + fallback chain; auto-breaker DEFERRED. Kanban board capability-router. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-21-capability-router-design.md.

Architecture: 3 layers — Pure core (signals, rules.match, lint, explain, tiers; no IO/state/model calls), Stateful shell (blocklist pre-filter, classify gated LLM call, cache+pin, decision_log), Adapter (route_hook: only Hermes-coupled code; calls delegate_profile).

router.yaml: two ordered first-match tables; non-Turing-complete (no loops/vars/nesting), OR=another row, closed operators, mandatory default. Two axes: PROFILE=role (coder/reviewer/researcher from cheap signals), MODEL=capability (T1-T4 from classifier).

Classifier: 4 tiers (T1 TRIVIAL=single mechanical edit; T2 SIMPLE=one file standard pattern; T3 MODERATE=2-5 files multi-step; T4 HARD=cross-cutting/correctness/concurrency/security). One-shot temp-0 glm-5.2/zai. Confidence upward-only ratchet. Fail-safe through blocklist. Recursion-guarded. Exact-hash cache + session model-floor pin (upward-only).

Blocklist: pre-filter, runs first. v1=static deny row (top of Table 1) + fallback chain (gpt-5.6-sol→glm-5.2). Fail-CLOSED. Auto-breaker DEFERRED (exit 124 ambiguous). In-band LLM enforcement via middleware fast-follow.

Kanban: board capability-router, project p_d7b1b409. Order: seed router.yaml (planner) → pure core (coder) → shell (coder) + CLI (scribe) → adapter (coder) → review (reviewer). Deferred: auto-breaker, WebUI, semantic cache, lib/plugin split, T3 tuning.

CLI: router explain (rule-tester), router lint (validator fail-closed), router blocklist, router log --tail. Decision log cause= set: {blocklist_veto, breaker_cooldown, keyword_match, size_rule, has_code_rule, classifier, session_pin, default_fallthrough, fail_safe_strong}.

ARCHITECTURAL GAP CLOSED (2026-07-22, commit 28c1dbe). The capability-router's route() function is NOW wired into delegate_profile delegation pipeline. When profile is omitted or 'auto', _route_task() runs Stage 0 deterministic rules (verb_class, has_code, keywords) without needing classifier. Stage 1 (LLM classifier via ctx.llm) fires only on rules with action:classify; if unavailable, falls to fail_safe (claude-opus). Blocklist manual deny and auto-breaker outcome recording also active. THE REMAINING ISSUE IS OPERATIONAL: delegate_profile competes with built-in delegate_task for agent tool selection — when deferred, the agent may pick the wrong tool. Verified: simulation shows handler correctly resolves profile='auto' + 'Debug race condition' → coder/claude-opus. 198 tests passing.

Hermes compaction incident root cause (verified 2026-07-24): the stall was not the threshold. auxiliary.compression used deepseek-v3.2, which was HTTP 429/quota-exhausted and had a 128K window below the 231K trigger. On summarizer failure Hermes inserts a fallback context marker instead of a summary, so history does not shrink, reaches the ceiling, and ends in Cannot compress further/compression_exhausted. Fix deployed: auxiliary.compression provider=auto with fallback chain zai/glm-4.5-flash then openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.

Capability Router quota self-heal was added in commit 3e12d9e (pushed): _is_exhaustion detects HTTP 429/402, usage_limit, insufficient balance/credits, weekly/monthly limits, and Z.AI code 1113. It classifies quota_exhausted as retryable=True, so execution advances to the next fallback; breaker weight 10 trips immediately and temporarily skips the exhausted provider.

Current Hermes WebUI tool-shell sandbox has NoNewPrivs=1, so the kernel blocks sudo and pkexec there. The gateway system-service process itself has NoNewPrivs=0. Gateway system-service restarts require Rodrigo to run `! sudo systemctl restart hermes-gateway-rodrigo` from his own CLI; this sandbox restriction is intentional security.

Safe WebUI restart workflow: `~/bin/hermes-safe-restart.sh <new-config>` validates YAML, maintains config.yaml.good, launches a detached systemd-run --user watchdog that survives WebUI/chat loss, atomically applies config, restarts WebUI, polls http://127.0.0.1:8787/health for up to 180s, and auto-reverts on failure. Drop-in hardening sets StartLimitIntervalSec=0 to avoid crash-loop lockout. It successfully promoted Track B in 18s on 2026-07-24.

Track B dynamic compaction thresholds are active in Rodrigo's Hermes config: compression.aggressiveness=50 (Balanced), threshold_tokens=650000, and per-model model_thresholds derived from window size. Examples: gpt-5.6-terra/luna/sol=0.766, glm-4.5-flash=0.847, Claude 1M-context keys=0.62. Formula: p_base(W)=0.85-0.0776*log2(W/128000); implementation is router/threshold.py in hermes-delegate-profile.

SSH remoto ao WSL (avell) FUNCIONA via funnel Tailscale: (1) sshd hardened porta 2222 — key-only, AllowUsers rodrigo, drop-in em /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-hermes-remote.conf aplicado via wsl-root-escape (wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-24.04 -u root); (2) Tailscale funnel no Windows (nó hermes, tag:service-host) — 'tailscale funnel --bg --tls-terminated-tcp=10000 tcp://127.0.0.1:2222' aplicado via HermesElevated scheduled-task bridge. Funnel só permite portas 443/8443/10000; modo --tls-terminated-tcp é o correto (Tailscale termina TLS no edge e entrega SSH puro ao sshd; --tcp puro NÃO funciona porque espera backend TLS e sshd não fala TLS); (3) Cliente externo conecta com 'ssh -i id_hermes_wsl -o ProxyCommand="openssl s_client -quiet -connect hermes.javanese-beta.ts.net:10000 -servername hermes.javanese-beta.ts.net" rodrigo@hermes.javanese-beta.ts.net'. O funnel HTTPS 443 do webui permanece intacto. Bridge neutro após uso: cmd.cmd = "rem No elevated operation configured."
